title: Griffith College Eanna claim first Super League title
description: Griffith College Eanna won their first ever InsureMyVan.ie Super League title, thanks to a 93-61 win over Pyrobel Killester in the final at the National Basketball Arena. They led from start to finish in this contest, establishing a 10 point advantage at the end of the first quarter, as Sean Jenkins (193-G-1999, college: Marian, IN) and Josh Wilson made excellent starts with 14 and 12 points respectively.
